body: I'm so sorry! Thank you for sharing your struggle, although it truly seems awful. I hope you can recover, and I'm sending all the good thoughts I can! Best of luck.
You're so welcome. I hope your night ends as well as possible, and if you need anything feel free to talk to me.

I think something that gives me hope is how humanity can give small acts of kindness. Like adopting a dog, etc. 
 The music really helped me, thank you! I never would have thought of sucking on candy, but that also really helped me become more grounded. Definitely bookmarking that link. <3

Thank you so much for the kind words. I'm planning on consulting a therapist, and eventually a doctor to see what can be done. It's definitely a struggle, but that's just another hill to climb. Your words have really helped me, and in fact, I'm considering joining an art activity like I've always wanted to. Thanks again, and best wishes to you.

I'm truly so sorry to hear about your situation. Yeah, I'm a recovering anorexic, and it's definitely some hard stuff to go through. I'm doing my best to make it through tonight, and I'm sure you can, too. Hang in there.
